name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A vertical list of events on a 1 px rail: an icon in a small circle per event, the time, a title, an optional note and file chips. Runs of events with the same day sit under one day label, and a Show more fold opens the rest with a height animation; new events slide in at the top.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>, MIT; free component, unchanged
